question: At the qualified R18 actual-108 state, does cardinality-two phase-anchor sufficiency hold across every unique rotation of the balanced contiguous half-cycle partition and a balanced parity partition, for each phase-plus-one-derived-coordinate projection?
hypothesis: R18 identified a general binary phase distinction rather than a boundary-specific code. Each of the eight complement-equivalent contiguous half-cycle rotations and the parity partition will reproduce full-five-coordinate membership in all four derived-coordinate panels.

prior_evidence.observation: The frozen R18 matrix classified coarsened_phase_resolution_supported: cardinality two was the first cardinality reproducing full-five-coordinate membership in all four phase-plus-derived panels, cardinalities four through sixteen remained matched, and cardinality one matched none.

scope_statement: This changes one dimension from R18: the geometry of the cardinality-two phase partition. Actual-108 records, streams, seeds, tuple width, four derived-coordinate panels, budget, exact set equality, capacity, induction, and evaluator-only audit remain fixed. It makes no population, task-learning, natural-language, or deployment claim.
authority: research-only; no deployment, external-model inference, scheduler, queue, accepted-ref, production, broker, live-interface, CKB-plane, or cross-lane authority

arms_and_inputs.full_five_coordinate_control: Exact R18 actual-108 records represented by sorted exact sets of [phase_anchor,prefix0,prefix1,suffix0,suffix1].
arms_and_inputs.r18_cardinality_two_control: Offset-zero contiguous partition must reproduce the R18 cardinality-two result in all four derived-coordinate panels.
arms_and_inputs.contiguous_rule: For phase index q=p-160 and offset o, bucket is 0 when ((q-o) mod 16) is in 0..7 and 1 otherwise. Offsets 8..15 are label complements, so offsets 0..7 are the eight unique unlabeled rotations.
arms_and_inputs.parity_rule: For phase index q=p-160, bucket=q mod 2.
arms_and_inputs.partition_panel: Evaluate the eight contiguous rotations followed by parity; for each partition evaluate [bucket,prefix0], [bucket,prefix1], [bucket,suffix0], [bucket,suffix1], for exactly thirty-six arms. Every arm uses identical actual-108 records; no source byte is mutated.
arms_and_inputs.evaluation: Exact projected-support equality, class cardinality, class-membership comparison, and evaluator-only entity audit; no task model is trained.

seeds.all_arms: Exact R6-R18 independent seeds; partition projection introduces no random draw.

controls: The local deterministic R18 probe must reproduce its frozen classification and exact controls before R19 output.
The full five-coordinate control must reproduce nine correct triplets with zero splits and zero cross-entity collisions.
Offset-zero contiguous cardinality two must exactly reproduce the R18 cardinality-two membership in all four derived-coordinate panels.
Every declared partition must place exactly eight phase indices in each bucket; reconstructed buckets must match the frozen formulas.
Offsets 0..7 must be pairwise distinct up to bucket-label complement and offsets 8..15 must reconstruct as their complements.
The complete nine-by-four partition matrix runs once in declared order; entity and family labels are unavailable to projection and induction and enter only the post-induction audit.
validity_criteria: Exact parent and North Star identities match.
The local deterministic R18 probe reproduces its frozen classification and controls before R19 output.
All thirty-six projections are constructed from identical actual-108 records with exactly one binary phase bucket and one declared derived coordinate.
The partition list is exactly contiguous offsets 0..7 followed by parity; every partition is balanced 8/8 and independently reconstructed.
Every arm has frozen cardinality, valid byte ranges, finite metrics, and exactly 36 unordered entity pairs audited.
Full Go regression passes before the probe.
No tokenizer, task training, external model, network call, capacity growth, fuzzy matching, seed search, adaptive arm selection, or evaluator leakage occurs.

classification_rules.binary_partition_geometry_invariant: Validity and controls pass; all eight contiguous rotations and parity reproduce full-five-coordinate membership in all four derived-coordinate panels.
classification_rules.contiguous_rotation_invariant_parity_spe: Validity and controls pass; all eight contiguous rotations reproduce all four memberships but parity does not.
classification_rules.boundary_specific_binary_sufficiency: Validity and controls pass; offset zero reproduces all four memberships but at least one other contiguous rotation does not.
classification_rules.derived_specific_partition_geometry: Validity and controls pass; at least one non-control partition matches some but not all derived-coordinate panels, and no preceding rule applies.
classification_rules.mixed: Validity and controls pass but none of the preceding scientific rules applies.
classification_rules.negative_control_failure: Any frozen R18, full-five-coordinate, offset-zero, balance, uniqueness, or complement control fails.
classification_rules.incomplete: Compute interruption prevents the complete fixed thirty-six-arm panel.
classification_rules.invalid: Any identity, construction, arm-cardinality, projection, balance, uniqueness, leakage, evaluator-boundary, determinism, finite-metric, or qualification criterion fails.

stop_conditions: Stop invalid before science on identity, R18 replication, full-five-coordinate control, offset-zero control, partition construction, build, or frozen-package drift.
After R19 output begins, complete all thirty-six partition arms and frozen evaluations unless infrastructure prevents it.
Do not add partitions, alter partition formulas, inspect alternate budgets, or change controls, metrics, thresholds, capacity, or classification after observing R19 output.
no_post_result_tuning_rule: No arm, partition, partition formula, derived coordinate, budget, context distribution, sample sequence, seed, representation rule, class learner, control, metric, threshold, capacity, stop condition, or interpretation may change after primary R19 output.
